backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Pepper Farm Bookkeeping app, handling user authentication, admin bootstrap registration, profile management, user approval workflows, and defining core data types for farm bookkeeping (income, expenses, inventory, etc.).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—approval-based dashboard access control and the admin User Verification panel—to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key functionality of every component, hook, and utility in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes, including background, foreground, card, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'Pepper Farm Bookkeeping Application' and mounting the app via the main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component orchestrating authentication state, bootstrap registration, profile loading, and approval checks to conditionally render the login prompt, loading spinner, WaitingForApprovalScreen, or Dashboard.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying the current year and a caffeine.ai attribution link with dynamic UTM parameters based on the app's hostname.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header showing the farm branding, the authenticated user's name, and a login/logout button that clears React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Landing page for unauthenticated users featuring a hero image and four feature cards highlighting income tracking, inventory, customer management, and the financial dashboard.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name on first login, submitting it via the `useSaveCallerUserProfile` mutation to complete profile setup.
frontend/src/components/RejectedScreen.t: Displays a full-page rejection notice when a user's access request has been denied, with a sign-out button that clears the identity and query cache.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AttendanceT: Renders a worker attendance register table with the ability to add new workers via a dialog; handles loading skeletons and error states with a retry option.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CustomersTa: Provides a searchable customer list with add-customer and purchase-history dialogs, using `useGetCustomers`, `useAddCustomer`, and `useGetCustomerPurchaseHistory` hooks.
Manages farm expense records with filterable/searchable table and dialogs for adding, editing, and deleting expenses, converting dates to nanoseconds for the backend.
frontend/src/components/tabs/FarmTimeTab: Displays a monthly calendar for tracking individual worker daily attendance records (arrival/departure times), with a dialog to create or update a day's record for the selected worker.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTab.t: React component for managing income records, providing a searchable/filterable table of records and a dialog form to add new income entries with amount, date, source, and description fields.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InventoryTa: React component for inventory management that displays a filterable table of inventory items and supports adding new items and editing existing ones via dialog forms.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SalesTab.ts: React component for recording and displaying sales, joining sale records with customer and inventory data for display, and providing a dialog form to record new sales transactions.
Dashboard summary tab that aggregates income, expenses, inventory value, low-stock alerts, and recent transactions into summary cards with loading skeleton states.
frontend/src/components/tabs/Verificatio: Admin tab for managing user access approvals, displaying a table of users with their approval status and confirmation dialogs to approve or reject individual users.
frontend/src/components/WaitingForApprov: Shows a pending-approval screen where users can send an approval request and manually refresh their approval status while waiting for an admin to grant access.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profiles, approvals, inventory, sales, income, expenses, customers, workers, and attendance records.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that renders a tabbed interface with sections for Summary, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time, and an admin-only Verification tab.
frontend/src/utils/farmTime.ts: Utility functions for the Farm Time calendar feature, including date/nanosecond conversions, month grid generation, time parsing/formatting, and duration formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, accordion animations, and enabling the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the 'Pepper Farm Bookkeeping' project, including existing implemented features and pending new feature requests related to a user verification/approval workflow.
